test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain cede language, 'CAMPHOR' is written as 'HZLOGNW' and 'FASTEN' is written as 'KZRSDS'. How will 'NATIONAL' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eae9f1ef4bf4780baeabf34845c2c65163fc2f459a4f7729f31daaf38d93bae1.png] 

'CAMPHOR' is written as 'HZLOGNW'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4948d21c4f594f89528c9e5697410708a66ec7470c8ab134a38ae948b32e8ff1.png] 

and,

'FASTEN' is written as 'KZRSDS'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99d8965880cc434c7122fffc94ac2f09de2bc1b9fbf30b9984741d91da9b2f2d.png] 

Similarly,

'NATIONAL' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6af9c663dfb0d5c8d7bb969647fee3c5157127a347c82ceb8e380a3a107c5e9d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "SZSHNMZQ".**
